posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
The pack you got isn't built for RPGMaker. That doesn't mean you can't use it, just that it'll be more work to get it into your game. It looks like the pack includes window skins, which will probably need fairly extensive editing to make them work with RPGMaker. The icons should be easier to integrate and mostly wouldn't even need a plugin; the buttons shouldn't be too hard either, but definitely need a plugin.
I think your first step should be to open up a paint program and sketch out what you want the UI to look like, copy-pasting from your graphics pack as needed. Make similar sketches for every possible UI in your game. If you can show us those sketches, perhaps we can point you in the right direction for building the UI you want.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
as a head up, rpg MV has a plugin "AltMenu3" which allows different background
on the scenes (which only need the opacity to 0), but MZ require a "rect".
modifying that plugin may work if you want background images.
for buttons, it require a plugin to recognize them, as I did so for MV only,
but single actor, so its purely the main menu.
I don't know how to alter it for MZ, but that should work if you create the images
for the buttons nicely.
but I would start => window skin alone does a lot with the game, so it isn't default.
or search similar for AltMenu3 for MV for something on MZ.
Maybe check
this one
(its paid but can change background per window).
I don't know if there are other that can do the same, but that it totally up to you.
